brief.detalle: Orders and numbers before the day starts.

plan.detalle: Your day laid out hour by hour, with what each hour is for.

entreno.detalle: Exercises, sets and loads based on the RPE you log.

dieta.detalle: Adjusted to your real weight and its trend, not to a table.

revision.detalle: Measures the week with your data and readjusts your system.

memoria.detalle: Remembers what it learns about you. Knows you better every week.

chat.detalle: Tell it and it does it: missions, schedule, rules, goals.

pro.linea: Your oath is sealed. The coach can lead your day from tomorrow.
pro.contexto: Your oath is sealed. NIVL stays fully free; Pro adds the coach that leads it.

web.subtitulo: NIVL and your habits stay free. Each paid mode opens its world and its coach: the AI that runs your day.
web.cuerpo: For now, the subscription is bought and managed in the NIVL app for iPhone. Nothing is charged on the web.
web.cuenta: It is the same account: the plan you have on your phone works here too.

pago.subtitulo: Each mode opens its world and its coach. NIVL and your habits stay free.
pago.notaTodos: IRON, FOCUS, WORK and FOUNDER, each with its coach.
pago.notaUno: This mode, its coach and the general coach.
pago.filaTodos: All four modes, with their coach
pago.noDisponible: Subscriptions are not available in this version of the app.
pago.errorPrecios: The store prices could not be loaded.

legal.tienda: Payment is charged to your store account and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

gestion.ios: Manage or cancel it anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
gestion.android: Manage or cancel it anytime in Google Play > Payments and subscriptions > Subscriptions.
gestion.otra: Manage or cancel it anytime from the store where you bought it.

legal.base: NIVL basics and your habits stay free. A mode adds its world and its coach, plus the general coach.
legal.avisoIa: NIVL is an AI, not a healthcare professional.
legal.uso: Automated or unusual use may pause the coach temporarily.

enlace.error: The link could not be opened.

aviso.pendiente: Purchase confirmed by the store. The mode opens in a few seconds; if it does not appear, tap Restore.
aviso.programada: Change confirmed by the store. It applies at your next renewal; until then you keep your current plan.
aviso.sinPermiso: To use the coach you need to agree to send your data to the AI provider. Without that permission nothing is charged.
aviso.nada: This store account has no active NIVL subscription.
aviso.cambio: You have {{actual}}. Only one subscription can be active: {{nuevo}} replaces the one you have, and you lose that mode once the change applies. The store tells you when.

cerrado.datos: What you logged here is still yours. Nothing is deleted for not paying.

queAbre.iron: Training, diet and its coach, which programs your loads and corrects your food.
queAbre.focus: Syllabus, exams and its coach, which spreads your study up to each date.
queAbre.work: Finances, schedule and its coach, which protects your workday.
queAbre.founder: Schedule, business finances and its coach, which asks you for the numbers.

plan.subPruebaTienda: Your free days. When they end, the store charges your plan unless you cancel first.
plan.subPrueba: Your 7-day trial. Brief, daily plan, training, diet, weekly review and memory. Nothing is charged at the end: it does not renew.
plan.subActivo: Brief, daily plan, training, diet, weekly review and memory. All active.
plan.agotadaFecha: Used up for this month. It refills on {{fecha}}. Your missions, streak and all modules keep working.
plan.agotadaDia1: Used up for this month. It refills on the 1st. Your missions, streak and all modules keep working.
plan.queda: {{pct}} % of what the coach can think through for you this month is left.
plan.quedaFecha: {{pct}} % of what the coach can think through for you this month is left. It fully refills on {{fecha}}.
plan.gestionarNota: There you change plan, see the renewal or cancel.
plan.fuera: This subscription was bought outside this app: manage and cancel it where you bought it.
plan.usoCoach: No counters or extra charges for using the coach. To protect the service, automated or unusual use may pause it temporarily; the rest of NIVL stays available.
plan.noComprobar: Your plan could not be checked.

tienda.noVinculada: The store is not linked to this account yet. Close and reopen NIVL and try again.
tienda.cuentaCambio: The account has changed. Try again.
tienda.otraCuenta: This store purchase belongs to another NIVL account. Sign in with that account to use it.
tienda.yaTiene: Your store account already has this subscription. Tap Restore purchases to recover it.
tienda.enCurso: A store operation is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
tienda.noResponde: The store is not responding right now. No new charge was completed: try again in a few minutes.
tienda.noPermite: This device does not allow purchases. Check the store restrictions.
tienda.noDisponible: That plan is not available in the store right now.
tienda.esperaPrecio: Wait for the store price to load.
tienda.canceladaVigente: Your subscription to this plan is cancelled but still active. Reactivate it from Manage or cancel subscription.
tienda.yaActivo: You already have this plan active in the store. If you do not see it in NIVL, tap Restore purchases.
tienda.pendientePago: The payment is awaiting approval in the store. Nothing was charged today: the coach will turn on when the store confirms it. If it takes a while, tap Restore purchases.
